title: Vague 'support' with 'the system' as actor
whyThisCase: 'Support user authentication' is a vague-verb plant (support without an operation list). 'The system' is a valid automated actor, so this is NOT an undefined-actor plant — only the missing operations should be flagged.

mustExtract.note: Must be extracted so the vague-verb issue has a unit to attach to.

ambiguities.note: Authentication operations are undefined (login, logout, password reset, MFA, …).

mustNotDetect.note: 'The system' is the actor. Do not flag this sentence as actor-undefined.

actorChecks.note: QualityScoreCalculator.HasActor must be true because of 'the system'.
